allow.reason: Stack exhaustion when merging recursive object graphs. Reached only through @prisma/config, which the Prisma CLI uses to read our own committed prisma config during migrations and client generation. No untrusted input reaches it. The only fix is Prisma 7, a major upgrade that changes client generation.
